NVDA.text: Nvidia fell 2.3% as a 5% semiconductor-index selloff and rising long-term Treasury yields pressured AI-chip shares; no distinct Nvidia-specific catalyst was confirmed.

AVGO.text: Broadcom fell 3.2% with the broad semiconductor rout as rising yields and profit-taking hit AI-hardware shares; no distinct Broadcom-specific catalyst was confirmed.

TSM.text: TSM fell 4.1% as the semiconductor selloff deepened amid rising long-term yields and broad AI-hardware profit-taking; no fresh TSM-specific catalyst was confirmed.

ASML.text: ASML fell 4.3% with semiconductor-equipment and AI-hardware shares as rising bond yields and broad chip de-risking pressured the sector; no distinct ASML-specific catalyst was confirmed.

KLAC.text: KLA fell 5.3% as the 5% semiconductor-index selloff spread through chip-equipment names amid rising yields and profit-taking; no fresh KLA-specific catalyst was confirmed.

INTC.text: Intel fell 6.6% during the broad semiconductor rout as rising yields and fading risk appetite hit chip shares; no distinct Intel-specific catalyst was confirmed.

MU.text: Micron fell 7.0%, among the day's hardest-hit chip names, as memory and AI-hardware shares sold off sharply amid profit-taking and rising-yield concerns; no fresh Micron-specific negative catalyst was confirmed.

DDOG.text: Datadog fell 0.5% as technology shares broadly weakened in a higher-yield, risk-off session; no distinct Datadog-specific catalyst was confirmed.

META.text: Meta fell 4.4% as a pivotal trial over social media's effects on children added company-specific legal pressure while the Nasdaq also dropped in a broader technology selloff.

PLTR.text: Palantir slipped 0.6% during a broader technology selloff driven by rising yields and AI-risk reduction; no distinct Palantir-specific catalyst was confirmed.

SPCX.text: SpaceX fell 2.0% after testing resistance near its initial trading price as space stocks broadly weakened; no fresh SpaceX operating catalyst was confirmed.
